prompt: User sends URL already captured — agent should detect duplicate and not re-capture

assertions.name: duplicate_detected
assertions.text: Agent detects the URL is already captured by matching normalized URL against existing notes

assertions.name: existing_note_referenced
assertions.text: Reply includes the existing note title and its file path

assertions.name: no_new_note_created
assertions.text: Agent does NOT create a new note file or attempt capture
